verses.1: And I heard a loud voice from the temple, saying to the seven angels: “Reveal and release the seven bowls of wrath of God upon the earth.”
verses.2: And the first one went away, and he carried his mark on the ground. Then there arose a curse and suffering upon those people who had the mark of that monster, and upon those who worshipped its image.
verses.3: And the second one threw his spear into the sea. Then blood like death flowed out, and all living souls died in the sea.
verses.4: And the third one brought its water to the rivers and springs. And water was created.
verses.5: And I heard the messenger of the waters say, “You are righteous, indeed you are righteous. You are holy, truly holy. For you have judged these things.”
verses.6: For the blood of the saints and prophets has been shed; you have given us this blood to drink. They are indeed worthy.
verses.7: And I heard from the altar that it said: “O Lord, the Almighty, your judgments are true and just.”
verses.8: And the fourth one carried his torch towards the sun. And he was given the task of burning people with fire.
verses.9: And the people were filled with great joy. They also cursed the name of the God who had power over these injuries. They refused to give him any glory.
verses.10: And the fifth one carried his statue onto the throne of the monster. Thus, his kingdom was destroyed. Their tongues were cut off from pain.
verses.11: And they besought the god of heaven for their relief from their sufferings and from their hardships. They did not give up in their efforts.
verses.12: And the sixth one carried his ship across the great river Euphrates. The water from that river became muddy, so that it could be used as a route for the kings from the east.
verses.13: And we saw from the mouth of the dragon, and from the mouth of the beast, and from the mouth of the false prophet, three impure spirits, like bats.
verses.14: For there are indeed spirits of demons that act as signs. These spirits spread throughout the kings of all nations, leading them into the war on the day of the great God, the Almighty.
verses.15: I see that I’m coming here as a thief. It would be good if I could catch up with him quickly and keep his clothes on, so that he wouldn’t have to walk around naked, and I could see the ugliness of his appearance.
verses.16: And he took them to the place called Hebraisti Hermagedon.
verses.17: And the seventh one raised his lamp into the air. Then a loud voice came from the temple, coming from the throne: “It has happened.”
verses.18: And earthquakes and voices and thunder occurred. A great earthquake also took place. It was such a severe earthquake that no one had ever experienced such a severe earthquake before on this earth.
verses.19: And the city became very large, divided into three parts. The cities of those nations were destroyed. Babylon, being a great city, was reminded by God that it would be given to it the cup of wine from His wrath.
verses.20: And all the islands fled away, and no mountains were found at all.
verses.21: And a great hail fell from the sky upon the people. The people feared God because of this hail; they knew that its damage was extremely severe.
